verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes Svelte's compiler and community sentiment but contains no documentation or example of embedding Svelte components into an existing non-Svelte page, using it as a widget, or scaling from partial to full adoption; the closest data point (svelte-comm-12) describes a full app migration, not incremental adoption. Missing for 10: docs on custom-element/web-component output, guidance on mounting into existing pages, and any case study of gradual adoption.
